summary.text: Gujarat won the match by 10 wickets on Day 4 during the first session. Gujarat scored 439-10 in their first innings with Vedant Trivedi as the top scorer with 108 runs off 171 balls, while ODSA had previously scored 324-10 with Gourav Choudhary scoring 137 runs off 298 balls. ODSA were later bowled out for 161-10 in their second innings, allowing Gujarat to easily chase the target with 27-0.
